title: Finland Scholarship
provider: Finnish Ministry of Education and Culture and Finnish universities
description: National scholarship for new degree students from outside the EU/EEA starting a master's programme at a Finnish university, awarded as part of the admission decision without a separate application.
amount: 100% tuition fee waiver for the first year plus a EUR 5,000 relocation grant

title: University of Helsinki International Scholarship
description: Scholarship for fee-paying students from outside the EU/EEA admitted to an English-taught master's programme, offered at tuition-only and tuition-plus-living levels.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver, with the higher tier adding a EUR 10,000 annual living allowance

title: Aalto University Scholarship
field: Technology, business, art and design, architecture
description: Merit-based scholarship for non-EU/EEA students admitted to an Aalto master's programme, covering part or all of tuition, with a small number also including a living-cost grant.
amount: 50% or 100% tuition fee waiver; selected awards add a EUR 8,000 relocation grant

title: University of Turku International Scholarship
description: Scholarship for fee-paying non-EU/EEA students admitted to a master's programme at the University of Turku, awarded on academic merit as part of admission.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver; the highest tier adds a EUR 7,000 first-year living grant

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (Finland-hosted programmes)
description: Fully funded, integrated master's programmes run by a consortium of universities across at least three countries, several coordinated by or including Finnish institutions. Students apply to the individual programme consortium.
amount: EUR 1,400 per month, full tuition, insurance and travel/installation allowances

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by programme, Oct 2026 - Jan 2027)
